Container.Name: Wissen
Container.Overview:
Wissen! is a knowledge archive for documentation and manuals that works on your existing folders. Markdown pages and PDFs live side by side: full-text search with OCR, a formatted editor with a switch to plain Markdown, versions and trash, pinned pages, callouts and Mermaid diagrams. Accounts and areas control who sees which top-level folder; a REST API and an MCP endpoint let tools and AI assistants read and write pages. Available in German, English, French and Italian.
First start: point "Pages" at the share that holds your pages and PDFs and open the web UI; the first visit (from your home network) creates the administrator account. Everything else (text recognition, home network, API keys, MCP, AI) is set in the app under Settings.
The app runs as nobody:users (PUID 99, PGID 100), the usual owner of Unraid shares. Empty folders created for the template are handed over to that user; existing folders are left as they are, so nobody:users needs write access there.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface. The container listens on 8000.

Config.Name: Pages
Config.Description: Your pages (.md) and PDFs. Each top-level folder becomes an area. Files are only changed, moved or renamed when you do it in the app.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Search index, settings, accounts and versions. The index rebuilds from the pages; accounts and settings do not, so include it in your backup.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: umask for new files and folders (0002 = group users may write).
